title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1973-09-07
lineage: AUDMC (AKG 1000 mic > Sony 110 deck. ) > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: A stellar 1973 audience tape that captures a fire‑filled second half with standout Bird Song, Here Comes Sunshine and the Truckin' → Eyes of the World jam, delivered in surprisingly clear AUD quality.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) source that many listeners describe as unusually clean – instrument separation is near‑perfect and the bird song segment shines. Musically the show is praised for its explosive second half, especially Bird Song, Playin', Here Comes Sunshine, Let It Grow and the extended Truckin' → Eyes of the World jam, though a few note a slow start and occasional static on Jerry’s guitar. Overall the performance is considered one of the best of ’73 despite minor technical blemishes.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer stars (mostly 5) and strong praise for both performance and audio clarity outweigh a few mixed comments about early‑set issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audible instrument separation, crisp bird song, occasional static on Jerry’s guitar and a slightly slow start; overall very listenable for an audience tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic second half with a powerful jam sequence; first set starts slowly due to tuning but still solid, overall pacing builds to a memorable climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Generally praised for being at his best, though some note equipment‑related fuzz/static that momentarily dulls his tone.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned only in passing about cryptic equipment remarks; no specific performance comment.
band_member_comments.Drums: Described as fabulous and driving, providing a strong rhythmic foundation throughout the show.
